headline: Pinkerton Academy FY2027-28 budget and tuition rates, budget and adequacy aid, and four policies up for first reading.
summary: Pinkerton Academy's FY2027-28 budget and tuition rates will be presented. Later items include budget and adequacy aid, two policies for second reading, and four policies for first reading.
items: Kid Governor presentation by Mr. Flynn
Pinkerton Academy FY2027-28 annual budget and tuition rates presentation
Public comment, up to 3 minutes per speaker and 30 minutes total
Policy BBBA, School Board Member Qualifications, second reading
Policy JIH, Searches of Students and Their Property, second reading
Policy GBEF, Acceptable Use - Staff, first reading
Policy IMDA, Patriotic Exercises, first reading
Policy JICL, Acceptable Use - Students, first reading
Policy KFA, Conduct on School Property, first reading
Public hearing on SAU budget, December 22, 2026
Possible nonpublic session under RSA 91-A:3, II
location: SAU Office, 28 South Main Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038
